description: Convert an APR (nominal yearly rate) to an APY (effective yearly rate) or back, for a compounding you choose. APY = (1 + APR / m)^m - 1 for m periods a year, e^APR - 1 when continuous. The same APY is a different APR at every compounding frequency, so the frequency is required: give periodsPerYear (365 daily, 12 monthly) or continuous true, not both. Rates are fractions (0.12 = 12%). It converts rate arithmetic only: it does not include fees, token price moves or the risk that a pool rate changes. Use when user asks "what APR is an 8% APY compounded daily?" or "what is 12% APR monthly as an APY?". Returns: apr, apy, periodsPerYear, continuous, ratePerPeriod, apyMinusApr, byCompounding (the same APY as an APR at annual, semiannual, quarterly, monthly, weekly, daily and continuous compounding).

continuous.description: True for continuous compounding; then omit periodsPerYear

direction.description: apr_to_apy converts the given APR into an APY; apy_to_apr the reverse

periodsPerYear.description: Compounding periods a year, 1 to 365 (12 monthly, 365 daily). Omit when continuous is true

rate.description: The rate you have, as a fraction per year (0.12 = 12%), up to 1000. An APY must be above -1; an APR must satisfy APR / periodsPerYear above -1

name: workflow.run_apy_apr_converter
title: Apy Apr Converter
